image_description: A grand, ornate pipe organ situated on a balcony within a Gothic-style cathedral. The organ features multiple vertical pipe arrays of varying heights and diameters, arranged in symmetrical clusters with decorative casework. The pipes appear to be made of polished metal (silver/tin) and dark wood. The background shows intricate stone vaulted ceilings and arches. A wooden railing surrounds the organ loft.

selected_experts.reason: To verify the specific taxonomic classification of the instrument as a 'pipe organ' and distinguish it from other large structures or generic organs.
To ensure the complex overlapping of pipes and the integration of the organ into the cathedral's vaulted ceiling have correct depth relationships and no spatial melting.
To check for boundary bleeding between the numerous thin pipes and the background, ensuring each pipe is a distinct, solid object without fusion artifacts.
To assess the overall texture quality of the stone walls and metal pipes, looking for subtle AI-generated smearing or noise patterns.
